title: AI in Agriculture: Revolutionizing Farming for a Sustainable Future
description: AI is used in agriculture for crop monitoring, precision farming, weather risk, yield forecasting, and decisions made with mud on the boots.
short_description: A practical guide to crop monitoring, precision farming, weather risk, labour pressure, and the field conditions that ruin tidy demos.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: Readers who want a grounded, non-technical view of AI in Agriculture, including farm operators, ag-tech teams, sustainability readers, and policy-minded observers.
